# CWE-798: Google API key — AIza... token in source.
# AIzaSy... keys are long-lived and billable. The rule flags them;
# ok is AIKA (wrong prefix) or short stubs that fail length checks.

 key=AIzaSyBGJlWlxZEnJ2yUape3AjqmNyo5--h6xtI

 AIKAblablablahblahbl
